We are situated on Glasgow's oldest iconic street, High Street, which is set in the vibrant Merchant City area. We are just a 5-minute walk away from Argyle Street and High Street train station. At Hair In The City, we love what we do. Our passionate, skilled staff are highly trained to listen and guide you through a thorough personal consultation and give you our honest, professional opinion making sure that the integrity of your hair and your hair goals are prioritised at all times. ​ As Glasgow's premier colour specialist salon, we are renowned for bespoke signature balayage, lived-in blondes, and advanced colour rescues. Led by our Salon Director Louise Wilson—a former professional colour educator—we specialise in complex Colour Correction and Signature Balayage and Blend treatments designed to restore hair health and deliver flawless, multi-dimensional shades. ​ Explore our range of services to see how we can help you achieve your hair goals. ​ Looking for instant length and luxurious volume? Our certified extensions team specialises in the safest, most discreet application methods. From Remi Cachet Tape Extensions to flat bonds, nano rings, and weaves, we source only double-drawn, 100% human Remy hair for seamless, natural-looking results. Book an Extensions Consultation & Colour Match today. ​ ​ ​We believe professional hair care should be comfortable and inclusive for everyone. Our dedicated, fully enclosed Private Hairdressing Room is available at no extra cost, providing a secure, female-only environment for Hijab-Friendly appointments and a calm, quiet space for Sensory-Safe styling and silent appointments Our clients love the homely, chilled vibe in the salon. pages.https://www.hairinthecity.co.uk/private-: Skip to Main Content HOME BOOK NOW SERVICES PRIVATE ROOM THE TEAM CONTACT More 0 A Private Hairdressing Room Designed Around You Discreet. Inclusive. Created with care for those who need a little more privacy. Book The Private Room Why We Created This Space At Hair in the City, we know that a traditional salon setting isn’t right for everyone. Whether you wear a hijab, are experiencing hair loss, regrowing your hair after chemotherapy, or feel more at ease in a calmer space, our private room was designed with you in mind. Tucked away from the main salon floor, it offers the quiet, dignity and care you deserve, whatever your reason for needing a bit more privacy. Although we have one make member of staff, we have have the facilities to ensure your privacy and modesty in the salon and when using the private room. Who This Room is For Our private space is open to anyone who needs or prefers it. It’s particularly well-suited to: ​ Clients experiencing hair loss or thinning who want privacy and discretion. ​ Those who wear religious head coverings (e.g. hijab, turban) and require modesty. Individuals managing social anxiety, neurodivergence, or sensory sensitivities. ​ LGBTQ+ clients looking for a non-judgemental, gender-neutral environment. ​ Clients who are recovering from chemotherapy, with hair beginning to grow back. ​ Anyone who simply prefers a calm, one-on-one space for their appointment Book a Hijab-Friendly Private Appointment Book a Sensory-Safe or Quiet Appointment ​ ​ Supporting You Through Post-Chemo Hair Regrowth Hair regrowth after chemotherapy is a sensitive and deeply personal experience. Louise has supported many clients, including her sister, at this stage in their journey and understands the emotions, questions, and practical concerns that come with it. Our private room provides the ideal setting for this important phase—free from distractions, full of empathy, and tailored to your needs. Louise Wilson - Salon Director What To Expect Here’s what you’ll find when you choose the private room: ​ A fully enclosed, peaceful space One stylist, one client, always Flexible options for music, silence, or conversation A judgement-free, inclusive atmosphere All the same expert care and services available in the main salon The backwash area is in a quiet part of the main salon floor How to Request the Private Room It is always best to telephone to book your appointment if you require the private room so we can check to ensure it will be avaiable for your appointment. Call the salon on 0141 5522848 to speak with one of the team who will be happy to confirm availability and book your appointment for you. . We welcome all clients with warmth and without assumptions. Your comfort is our priority. Book Your Next Appointment FAQs Q: Do I need to book the private room in advance? A: It’s helpful to mention it when booking so we can make sure it’s available, but we’ll always do our best to accommodate you, even on short notice. Q: Can I bring someone with me? A: Yes, you’re welcome to bring a friend, family member, or support person with you. ​ Q: Is the room wheelchair accessible? A: Yes, the salon and private room are fully accessible. ​ Q: Can I have any treatment done in the private room? A: Most services can be offered in the room—just let us know what you’re looking for when you book. pages.https://www.hairinthecity.co.uk/services: Skip to Main Content HOME BOOK NOW SERVICES PRIVATE ROOM THE TEAM CONTACT More 0 Tinting & Toning Services Colour Correction Lead Expert: Louise Wilson Price (from): Price upon consultation ABOUT THE SERVICE If you've experienced a home-dye disaster, had an uneven colour application elsewhere, or want to make a dramatic colour transition (such as dark box dye to clean blonde), our specialist Colour Correction service at Hair In The City Glasgow is here to help. Led by our Salon Director Louise Wilson—a former educator in professional hair colour chemistry—we specialise in repairing complex hair colour issues. We restore your hair’s health, neutralise brassiness or green tones, and reconstruct a beautiful, rich shade you can be proud of. WHAT TO EXPECT: THE PROCESS 1 Step 1 Mandatory Colour & Structure Consultation: We assess your hair’s history, perform strength and elasticity tests, and use test strands to see how your hair responds to lift. We provide a clear plan, timeframe, and cost estimate. 2 Step 2 Colour Extraction or De-colourising: We carefully remove artificial colour pigments or blockages from previous home dyes or uneven treatments using gentle colour reducers or lifting agents. 3 Step 3 Internal Bond Reinforcement: Throughout the lifting phase, we mix Keune Bond Fusion Phase 1 into all lighteners and extractors to rebuild broken disulphide bonds and protect the hair's structural integrity. 4 Step 4 Neutralisation & Shading: We apply targeted colour correcting washes or pigments to neutralise unwanted tones (red, orange, or green undertones) and bring your hair back to a clean, workable canvas. 5 Step 5 Re-pigmenting & Target Shade Application: Once the base colour is corrected, we apply a premium Keune Semi or Permanent Colour to achieve your target shade—creating rich brunettes, soft coppers, or clean blondes. 6 Step 6 Keune Deep Conditioning & Bond Savior Service: We apply Bond Fusion Phase 2 at the basin to seal the cuticle, lock in moisture, and leave your hair feeling soft, shiny, and strong. 7 Step 7 Signature Cut & Finish: A professional cut to remove dry or damaged split ends, followed by styling to showcase your healthy, revitalized colour. WHO THIS IS IDEAL FOR Home Dye Mistakes: Ideal for correcting uneven banding, patchiness, or incorrect shades from box dyes. Transitioning from Dark to Light: Perfect if you have years of built-up dark hair colour and want to safely go lighter. Tonal Correction: Suitable for neutralizing brassy, green, or muddy hair tones and restoring vibrancy. Damaged Hair Recovery: Ideal for hair that has been over-processed and needs expert structural repair and colour blending. AFTERCARE & MAINTENANCE Deep Repair Washing: Use Keune Care Vital Nutrition shampoo and conditioner to feed protein and moisture back into the hair. Cuticle Shielding: Apply Keune Care Keratin Smooth Silky Oil before styling to protect against heat damage and lock in shine. Regular Trim Schedules: Keep split ends at bay with a Cut & Style appointment every 6 weeks. Tonal Refreshes: Book a Gloss & Tone treatment every 4 to 6 weeks to keep your shade vibrant and prevent fading. All styling starts with a personal consultation to tailor the perfect finish. BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT → FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Q: Why does colour correction require a prior consultation? A: Every hair correction is unique. We must test your hair's strength, elasticity, and how it responds to colour lifters. A consultation allows us to perform a strand test, calculate an accurate price, and set realistic expectations for what can be achieved in a single session. Q: How much does a Colour Correction service cost? A: Because of the unique complexity of correcting hair colour, pricing is determined individually during your consultation. It depends on the number of steps required, the product used, and the total time. Our colour consultations are £20.00, which is deducted from your final booking fee. Q: Can you fix green or orange hair after a home bleaching attempt? A: Yes! Orange hair occurs when hair isn't lifted enough, leaving warm raw pigments. Green hair usually occurs when ash blonde dye is applied over yellow hair without a warm filler. We use colour theory to counteract these tones and restore a beautiful, natural shade. Q: How many sessions will it take to correct my hair? A: Many minor corrections can be resolved in a single 4 to 5-hour session. However, extreme transformations (like shifting from years of black box dye to clean blonde) may require 2 to 3 sessions spread over several weeks to protect your hair's health. Q: What is the risk of hair breakage during colour correction? A: We never compromise hair health. Louise Wilson uses her extensive educator background to assess hair strength first. If a strand test indicates your hair is too fragile, we will recommend a conditioning and protein treatment plan (such as Keune Bond Fusion) to strengthen it before colouring. Q: Who will perform my Colour Correction service? A: Our Salon Director, Louise Wilson, is our primary expert for all complex colour corrections. Louise has over 25 years of industry experience and is a former colour educator, making her one of Glasgow's leading authorities on colour rescue. Q: Do I need a patch test before my appointment? A: Yes. A colour patch test must be carried out at least 48 hours before any chemical application. This is a quick 2-minute skin test at our High Street salon to ensure you have no allergic reaction to our professional Keune colour range. MEET YOUR LEAD EXPERT: LOUISE WILSON Salon Director & Owner Louise has built her career on exceptional client care, training the next generation of stylists, and traveling the UK for advanced education. She is passionate about creating a homely, inclusive environment. Unlike traditional highlights, our signature freehand hair painting technique creates a soft, graduated lightness that blends seamlessly from your natural root colour down to brightened ends. By custom-painting every section, our expert colourists design a bespoke dimension that grows out beautifully without harsh regrowth lines, meaning fewer salon visits and healthier hair. WHAT TO EXPECT: THE PROCESS 1 Step 1 In-Depth Colour Consultation: We discuss your hair history, desired blonde or brunette tones, skin undertones, and maintenance preferences to map out your custom balayage placement. 2 Step 2 Precision Sectioning & Mapping: We section the hair strategically based on your natural fall, head shape, and where the sun naturally hits. 3 Step 3 Freehand Painting (Hand-Painted Lightener): Using premium, ammonia-free clay lighteners, we sweep lightener onto the surface of the hair, diffusing it toward the root for a soft, blended transition and concentrating the saturation at the mid-lengths and ends. 4 Step 4 Bond Fusion Protection: We integrate Keune Bond Fusion into our lightener formula to repair and rebuild the hair’s internal bonds, ensuring your hair remains strong, shiny, and hydrated during the lifting process. 5 Step 5 Custom Toning Gloss: Once the desired lift is achieved, we apply a bespoke Keune Semi Colour gloss or toner at the backwash to neutralise brassiness, add rich multi-dimensional tones, and lock in glass-like shine. 6 Step 6 Basin Massage & Conditioning Treatment: A relaxing head massage with Keune Care Satin Oil or Vital Nutrition range to deeply nourish the hair cuticle. 7 Step 7 Signature Blowdry & Style: We finish with a professional cut, dry, and styling—perfecting your blend and styling it into signature beachy waves or a bouncy finish that showcases the dimensional colour. WHO THIS IS IDEAL FOR Low-Maintenance Lovers: Perfect if you want beautiful, dimensional colour but can only visit the salon every 12 to 16 weeks. Natural Transitions: Ideal for brunettes looking to go lighter without the harsh contrast of traditional highlights, or blondes wanting a lived-in, rooty blend. All Hair Types: Suitable for straight, wavy, curly, or textured hair looking to add depth, movement, and visual thickness. AFTERCARE & MAINTENANCE Sulphate-Free Care: Wash with Keune Care Colour Brillianz shampoo and conditioner to lock in colour and extend vibrancy. Silver & Violet Toning: Use Keune Care Silver Savior shampoo once a week to neutralize unwanted warm or yellow tones. Regular Gloss Refreshes: Book a Gloss & Tone service every 6 to 8 weeks between your main balayage appointments to keep your tone looking fresh, bright, and glossy. All styling starts with a personal consultation to tailor the perfect finish. BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT → FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Q: What is the main difference between a signature balayage and standard foils? A: Balayage is a freehand sweeping technique that creates a soft, blended transition with a darker, natural root and lighter ends. Foils are structured and go right to the root, giving a more uniform, high-contrast brightness from root to tip. Balayage offers a much softer, lower-maintenance grow-out than foils. Q: How long does a Signature Balayage and Blend appointment take? A: A typical signature balayage appointment takes between 3 to 4 hours. This allows ample time for custom placement, processing, Bond Fusion treatment, glossing, and a professional cut and finish. Q: Will a balayage damage my hair? A: At Hair In The City, hair health is our top priority. We use premium Keune lighteners infused with protective nourishing agents and incorporate Keune Bond Fusion into every lightening service. This system actively rebuilds and shields your hair's internal structure during lifting, leaving it stronger and shinier than standard bleaching. Q: Do I need a skin patch test before my balayage? A: Yes. If you are a new client or if it has been more than 6 months since your last colour service with us, you must pop into the salon at 14 High Street for a quick, free 48-hour colour patch test before your scheduled appointment. Q: Can I get a balayage if I have dark brown or black hair? A: Absolutely! We specialise in creating rich caramel, honey, and warm copper balayage blends on dark hair. If your goal is a very bright, cool blonde, it may take 2 to 3 sessions to lift your hair safely while maintaining its health. Q: How often do I need to get my balayage touched up? A: One of the best benefits of our Signature Balayage is its longevity. Most clients only need their full balayage touched up every 12 to 16 weeks. We recommend booking a Gloss & Tone and a trim at the 6 to 8-week mark to refresh the tone and keep your ends healthy. Q: Is the price tier different if I book with a Senior Stylist vs. a Graduate Stylist? A: Yes. We operate on a tiered pricing system reflecting our team's experience. A Signature Balayage and Blend starts at £110.00 with our talented Graduate Stylists (Erin and Katie) and ranges up to £165.00 with our Salon Director (Louise).
